selectedFunctions.label: Origami Finance SKY+ deposit
warnings: Static deployment-bound source/ABI metadata only: not runtime attestation, live funding/liquidity, financial safety, execution or complete-workflow assurance. Existing grants, pauses, independent policies and canonical calldata validation remain required; selected calls are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Origami Finance SKY+ is its own Ethereum OrigamiDelegated4626Vault 0x07c5500359161b81eb0DfFF83097d5025D3cF5A2, not a relabeled Morpho curator vault. It issues 18-decimal SKY+ shares for SKY 0x56072c95faa701256059aa122697b133aded9279. Direct vault and current manager 0xc522335fBfe21d7A7d1135eb0E016a89DA49dC9e have exact_match source and no proxy; elevated governance can replace the manager and token-prices dependency.

deposit/mint atomically pull SKY from msg.sender directly to the configured manager via allowance to the vault, then manager locks it in immutable Sky LockstakeEngine 0xce01c90de7fd1bcfa39e237fe6d8d9f569e8a6a3 in its own urn. Shares mint to receiver, which need not be caller. No arbitrary zap/swap bytes, caller-selected manager, flash callback or standalone prefunding capability is admitted.

withdraw/redeem spend caller allowance on sharesOwner only when caller differs from owner, burn owner shares, and ask the manager (onlyVault) to free SKY directly to nonzero receiver. Fees from Sky unstaking are reflected in withdrawalFeeBps rounded up from WAD to basis points; manager gross-ups assets with floor rounding before LockstakeEngine.free. Actual assetsWithdrawn from manager is ignored by vault hook, so advertised assets are not a persistent exact-output guarantee when external fee/rounding changes.

Conversions use (totalSupply+assetScalar)/(totalAssets+1) virtual offsets; this SKY vault has scalar=1. deposit/redeem round outputs down, mint/withdraw round requirements up. In-kind deposit/withdraw fees affect shares; no caller-set minimum shares/assets, maximum assets/shares or deadline argument exists. Current observed deposit/exit fees were zero and performance fee allocation 0/200 bps; rates/settings are mutable and not promised.

Vault totalAssets includes manager idle SKY plus Sky Vat urn collateral and excludes unclaimed rewards and non-SKY rewards already forwarded for Cow Swap. Harvest timing, donations, Sky farm changes, conversion rounding and reinvestment affect share price. Rewards harvesting/swapping/admin controls are not admitted; configured reward swapper/farms remain dependencies, not isolation or backing guarantees.

Deposits/mints are subject to maxTotalSupply, seeding and manager pause; withdrawals/redeems to share balance/allowance, exit pause and external Sky availability/restrictions. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are share-based and do not attest immediate external cash availability; no asynchronous request/claim queue is implemented by these selected entrypoints. Fully exiting resets supply cap to zero and requires privileged reseeding before future deposits.

Primary current docs list SKY+ outside Deprecated Vaults and describe its SKY staking/reward-harvesting strategy; current official app bundle includes this exact token/deployment and SKY+ collection. V3 OPAL products are distinct and not silently substituted for this V2 SKY+ vault. Source has no selected-function KYC/user whitelist but this is not app/jurisdictional eligibility clearance.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

asset().details: Returns the address of the underlying token used for the Vault for accounting, depositing, and withdrawing. - MUST be an ERC-20 token contract. - MUST NOT revert.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

totalAssets().details: Returns the total amount of the underlying asset that is “managed” by Vault. - SHOULD include any compounding that occurs from yield. - MUST be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT revert.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value must be included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}. Every successful call to {permit} increases ``owner``'s nonce by one. This prevents a signature from being used multiple times.

maxMint(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the Vault shares that can be minted for the receiver, through a mint call. - MUST return a limited value if receiver is subject to some mint limit. - MUST return 2 ** 256 - 1 if there is no limit on the maximum amount of shares that may be minted. - MUST NOT revert.

revokeOwnership().details: To enforce a two-step revoke, it must first propose to 0x000...dEaD prior to calling. This cannot be undone.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.

maxRedeem(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of Vault shares that can be redeemed from the owner balance in the Vault, through a redeem call. - MUST return a limited value if owner is subject to some withdrawal limit or timelock. - MUST return balanceOf(owner) if owner is not subject to any withdrawal limit or timelock. - MUST NOT revert.

maxDeposit(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be deposited into the Vault for the receiver, through a deposit call. - MUST return a limited value if receiver is subject to some deposit limit. - MUST return 2 ** 256 - 1 if there is no limit on the maximum amount of assets that may be deposited. - MUST NOT revert.

maxWithdraw(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be withdrawn from the owner balance in the Vault, through a withdraw call. - MUST return a limited value if owner is subject to some withdrawal limit or timelock. - MUST NOT revert.

previewMint(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their mint at the current block, given current on-chain conditions. - MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of assets that would be deposited in a mint call   in the same transaction. I.e. mint should return the same or fewer assets as previewMint if called in the   same transaction. - MUST NOT account for mint limits like those returned from maxMint and should always act as though the mint   would be accepted, regardless if the user has enough tokens approved, etc. - MUST be inclusive of deposit fees. Integrators should be aware of the existence of deposit fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToAssets and previewMint SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by minting.

mint(uint256,address).details: Mints exactly shares Vault shares to receiver by depositing amount of underlying tokens. - MUST emit the Deposit event. - MAY support an additional flow in which the underlying tokens are owned by the Vault contract before the mint   execution, and are accounted for during mint. - MUST revert if all of shares cannot be minted (due to deposit limit being reached, slippage, the user not   approving enough underlying tokens to the Vault contract, etc). NOTE: most implementations will require pre-approval of the Vault with the Vault’s underlying asset token.

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their redeemption at the current block, given current on-chain conditions. - MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of assets that would be withdrawn in a redeem call   in the same transaction. I.e. redeem should return the same or more assets as previewRedeem if called in the   same transaction. - MUST NOT account for redemption limits like those returned from maxRedeem and should always act as though the   redemption would be accepted, regardless if the user has enough shares, etc. - MUST be inclusive of withdrawal fees. Integrators should be aware of the existence of withdrawal fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToAssets and previewRedeem SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by redeeming.

previewDeposit(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their deposit at the current block, given current on-chain conditions. - MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of Vault shares that would be minted in a deposit   call in the same transaction. devdoc.details: Uses an immutable SKY Lockstake Engine. If that ever changes, a new vault will be deployed. Users would need to withdraw from Origami Vault A and deposit into Origami Vault B.

asset().details: - MUST be an ERC-20 token contract. - MUST NOT revert.

totalAssets().details: - SHOULD include any compounding that occurs from yield. - MUST be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT revert.

params.assetsAmount: The amount of assets to deposit. Implementation MAY choose to accept  type(uint256).max as a special value indicating the full balance of the contract

deposit(uint256).details: Implementation SHOULD assume the tokens have already been sent to this contract

getFarm(uint256).details: Does not revert - A farm index is invalid if the farmIndex is > 0 and `farm.staking` is address(0)

revokeOwnership().details: To enforce a two-step revoke, it must first propose to 0x000...dEaD prior to calling. This cannot be undone.

removeFarm(uint32).details: This will revert if there's still a staked balance or rewards to claim. If a farm is removed, the `maxFarmIndex` doesn't decrease

farmDetails(uint32[]).details: If the farmIndex is not valid/removed that item will remain  empty

setPaused((bool,bool)).details: Can only be called by allowed pausers.

addFarm(address,uint16).details: Only a maximum of 100 farms can be added. Will revert if the same `stakingAddress` is  added a second time.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[EIP section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

withdraw(uint256,address).details: - Fails if it can't withdraw that amount - type(uint256).max is accepted, meaning the entire balance

setPerformanceFees(uint16,uint16).details: Total fees cannot increase, but the ratio can be changed. Fees are distributed when claimFarmRewards() is called

_farms.details: The mapping of farm details. `farmIndex` at index zero is empty, as that represents holding  raw SKY in the urn (as LSSKY) rather than staking in a farm

currentFarmIndex.details: - index 0: Raw SKY is held in the assigned Lockstake Engine urn - index 1+: A SKY is staked in a farm

# Vault Synopsis

The SKY+ vault accepts deposits denominated in SKY.

MakerDAO having rebranded as SKY Protocol is a decentralised organisation launched with the aim of providing stability to cryptocurrency economies through its collateral backed stablecoin DAI which has surpassed more than 5 Billion in circulating supply. DAI is always exchangeable 1:1 for USDS and vice versa.

The SKY+ vault allows users the flexibility of earning yield on their SKY as part of the [Endgame roadmap](https://sky-atlas.powerhouse.io/A.4.1.2.1.4_MKR_To_SKY_Upgrade_Phase_Three/1f1f2ff0-8d73-80f8-9345-f50e357c1f9e%7Cb341f4c0b83472dc) wherein MKR token utility as the governance token will be slowly transitioned to SKY as the main governance token of the SKY protocol once the necessary development for the infrastructural changes are completed.

Users deposit SKY into the SKY+ vault for shares 2. Users burn their shares of SKY+ for SKY when exiting 3. SKY+ deploys SKY to SKY by holding SKY reserves 4. Origami sets discreet orders for swapping SKY yield farmed to SKY growing the vault reserves 8. Orders are trustlessly matched on Cow Swap orderbooks

sourceSemantics: Origami Finance SKY+ is its own Ethereum OrigamiDelegated4626Vault 0x07c5500359161b81eb0DfFF83097d5025D3cF5A2, not a relabeled Morpho curator vault. It issues 18-decimal SKY+ shares for SKY 0x56072c95faa701256059aa122697b133aded9279. Direct vault and current manager 0xc522335fBfe21d7A7d1135eb0E016a89DA49dC9e have exact_match source and no proxy; elevated governance can replace the manager and token-prices dependency.

deposit/mint atomically pull SKY from msg.sender directly to the configured manager via allowance to the vault, then manager locks it in immutable Sky LockstakeEngine 0xce01c90de7fd1bcfa39e237fe6d8d9f569e8a6a3 in its own urn. Shares mint to receiver, which need not be caller. No arbitrary zap/swap bytes, caller-selected manager, flash callback or standalone prefunding capability is admitted.

withdraw/redeem spend caller allowance on sharesOwner only when caller differs from owner, burn owner shares, and ask the manager (onlyVault) to free SKY directly to nonzero receiver. Fees from Sky unstaking are reflected in withdrawalFeeBps rounded up from WAD to basis points; manager gross-ups assets with floor rounding before LockstakeEngine.free. Actual assetsWithdrawn from manager is ignored by vault hook, so advertised assets are not a persistent exact-output guarantee when external fee/rounding changes.

Conversions use (totalSupply+assetScalar)/(totalAssets+1) virtual offsets; this SKY vault has scalar=1. deposit/redeem round outputs down, mint/withdraw round requirements up. In-kind deposit/withdraw fees affect shares; no caller-set minimum shares/assets, maximum assets/shares or deadline argument exists. Current observed deposit/exit fees were zero and performance fee allocation 0/200 bps; rates/settings are mutable and not promised.

Vault totalAssets includes manager idle SKY plus Sky Vat urn collateral and excludes unclaimed rewards and non-SKY rewards already forwarded for Cow Swap. Harvest timing, donations, Sky farm changes, conversion rounding and reinvestment affect share price. Rewards harvesting/swapping/admin controls are not admitted; configured reward swapper/farms remain dependencies, not isolation or backing guarantees.

Deposits/mints are subject to maxTotalSupply, seeding and manager pause; withdrawals/redeems to share balance/allowance, exit pause and external Sky availability/restrictions. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are share-based and do not attest immediate external cash availability; no asynchronous request/claim queue is implemented by these selected entrypoints. Fully exiting resets supply cap to zero and requires privileged reseeding before future deposits.

Primary current docs list SKY+ outside Deprecated Vaults and describe its SKY staking/reward-harvesting strategy; current official app bundle includes this exact token/deployment and SKY+ collection. V3 OPAL products are distinct and not silently substituted for this V2 SKY+ vault. Source has no selected-function KYC/user whitelist but this is not app/jurisdictional eligibility clearance.
